Runs the CLI steps and browser checkpoints. Switches to VERIFIER and LAB_USER runtime accounts when prompted.
UC-4 delivery; UC-11 verification support; UC-2/3 runtime behavior. PBI-011.6 / PBI-011; evidence PBI-012.
D qualifies an existing archive. It does not export C, rebuild the archive, promote user_acceptance_test or copy developer data.

1. Prerequisites
Require C_world.done; create a new D attempt directory.

2. Select + inspect archive
initial-selected.txt → immutable reviewed 1.0.0 archive.
Check SHA-256, members, manifest and source/candidate identity.

3. Read status
Archive controller: status. Read current integration_test epoch.

4. Admit empty target
Prompt → admit with expected epoch.
Record ownership/attempt; advance epoch; runtime remains gated.

5. Migrate
Prompt → migrate. SQLcl Liquibase validate → update → status.
Initial archive migrations 001–004, not checkout patch migrations.

6. Import
Prompt → import native split source into app 810004.
Map E1_INTEGRATION; assert ordinary runtime is still blocked.

7. Units + integrity
Prompt → units. Versions/pages/compilation, composition/history.
Transactional unit fixtures roll back.

8. Enable verification
Prompt → verify. Integrity + no packaged business data.
Allow VERIFIER; mark attempt verifying. Browser test is next.

9. Retrieve VERIFIER password
Second terminal: python3 scripts/cicd-password.py VERIFIER

10. Browser as VERIFIER
integration_test URL: create Hello/World, configure defaults,
save Hello World and refresh history. Leave CLI waiting.

11. Publish integration_test
Continue CLI. Require saved VERIFIER snapshot; prepare native
availability; fingerprint; commit ready gate + success receipt.

12. Check result
Ready state, versions, same archive hash and matching live
fingerprint. Mark D complete only after result succeeds.

13. Retrieve LAB_USER password
Second terminal: python3 scripts/cicd-password.py LAB_USER

14. Browser as LAB_USER
Sign out of VERIFIER; use integration_test app; create a greeting
and refresh history. Confirm ordinary access after publication.

15. Finish D
Return to CLI; press key → PASS result stage D_integration_test.
Next: E promotes the same qualified archive to user_acceptance_test.
